# Finishing PR #12: pre-menu stop checkpoints for the rework subject

**Inputs**
- `WORKTREE=/work/widget/.worktrees/retry`, `PRIMARY=/work/widget`, `FEATURE=retry`.
- Subject: a rework PR subject. Home is acme/widget#12, which is OPEN, has `headRefName` retry, and targets `<base-branch>` main.
- Per Step 1, home is confirmed with `gh pr view 12 --json number,url,headRefName,baseRefName,state`.
- SHA aliases used below:
  - A = `aaaaaaaa…` (`PRE_REWORK_HEAD`, home)
  - C = `cccccccc…` (member #13's original head)
  - D = `dddddddd…` (recorded Rework base)
  - E = `eeeeeeee…` (HEAD)
- The record form is rebase mode, because `Base: main @ 1234567 - rebased: aaaaaaa..ddddddd` is recorded. Merge mode is never selected: only a `Base:` written in `merge:` form selects it. None of the variants below can fall back to merge mode.
- Steps 1-3.5 (verification, conformance) are assumed passed for these synthetic checkpoints. Nothing is executed.

## Stop variants (independent)

| # | Record state | Where it stops | Exact stop | Menu | Push / body | Merge mode |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `Rework base: D` recorded; D is not an ancestor of E | After `git -C "$WORKTREE" fetch origin`, at the one-time proof `git -C "$WORKTREE" merge-base --is-ancestor D HEAD`, which exits 1 | `PR branch history was rewritten: ddddddd is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must restart from the recorded rework base.` | not reached | none; the origin-equality check against A is never evaluated | no |
| 2 | `Base: … sync: unresolved`, members `pending`, no `Rework base:` | Record-form read, before fetch | `rework sync incomplete for PR #12: no Rework base recorded; finish Task 1 first.` | not reached | none | no |
| 3 | Home rebased, but `Member replay: #13 unresolved`/`pending`, no `Rework base:` | Record-form read, before fetch | `rework sync incomplete for PR #12: no Rework base recorded; finish Task 1 first.` | not reached | none | no |
| 4 | `Base: main @ 1234567 - rebased: aaaaaaa..ddddddd`, no `Rework base:` line | Record-form read, before fetch. This is a rebase record without `Rework base:`, so it gets the same stop | `rework sync incomplete for PR #12: no Rework base recorded; finish Task 1 first.` | not reached | none | no |

In each variant, the stop message would open with `gauntlet: stuck` and then the reason shown above. No terminal `done` marker is emitted.

## What none of the variants do
- Run the strip-and-seal block or telemetry seal.
- Write the `refs/gauntlet/pre-rework/pr-12` or `pr-13` update-refs.
- Run either push form: the `--force-with-lease=retry:A` lease push or the non-force push.
- Fetch the body or run `gh pr edit`.
- Refetch threads.
- Show the close-member gate.

`phase_tracker` ship stays started and is not completed. The worktree and the `retry` branch are preserved, with no Step 6 cleanup.

## Member #13
#13 remains open in all four variants. Closure is only offered after a successful push and a successful home body edit, and neither is reached here. Report:

```
Member PRs #13 left open.
```

For variants 2-4, the fix is to complete Task 1: replay #13 onto home, then persist `refs/gauntlet/rework-base/pr-12` and the `Rework base:` line. After that, rerun finishing. Variant 1 requires restarting the rework from the recorded rework base. It must not be reset or forced.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.text:
SHA aliases: home original `aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa`; member #13 original `cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc`; Rework base `dddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddddd`; HEAD `eeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeee`.

| Independent checkpoint | Exact stop | Menu / push reached? | Merge mode allowed? |
|---|---|---|---|
| Recorded Rework base is not an ancestor of HEAD | `PR branch history was rewritten: ddddddd is not an ancestor of HEAD; the rework must restart from the recorded rework base.` | No / No | No |
| Base says `sync: unresolved`, members pending, no Rework base | `rework sync incomplete for PR #12: no Rework base recorded; finish Task 1 first.` | No / No | No |
| Home sync completed, but member #13 is unresolved/pending and no Rework base exists | `rework sync incomplete for PR #12: no Rework base recorded; finish Task 1 first.` | No / No | No |
| Base records a rebase, but Rework base is absent | `rework sync incomplete for PR #12: no Rework base recorded; finish Task 1 first.` | No / No | No |

Only a `Base:` record in `merge:` form selects merge mode. None of these cases permits falling back to merge mode.

No commands, push, description edits, or PR closure are executed. Member PR #13 remains open in every variant.
